svg.text: Ratings separate ideophones from prosaic words; guessing doesn’t.
Each mark is one word — the backdrop is McLean 2023’s 304 items,
the ink dots the 30 thesis pairs.
The two measures see different things — ρ ≈ +.44 overall, +.65 within ideophones (McLean, Dunn & Dingemanse 2023).
McLean, Dunn & Dingemanse (2023), Two measures are better than one — the 304-item backdrop, data CC BY 4.0.
Paulsson (2026), MA thesis — the study this arena replicates (30 pairs, 36 participants).
Each layer standardized within its own study; compare within a layer, not across.
